newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks rebound in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks rebound in early morning.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rebounded in early Tuesday morning trade although high-technology issues were weak due to profit-taking, brokers said.

They said the market had been ready for a rebound after recent sharp falls by indices, but rises in high-priced electronics issues which had been supporting the market were slowing down and upward momentum could be limited.
After 29 minutes of trade, the Nikkei average was up 85.51 points or 0.43 perent at 19,753.58. Its September futures were down 30 at 19,760.
